q: How does a Morbi wall clock maker work out carbon per clock?
title: Morbi wall clocks: carbon per clock
short: Share the unit's monthly electricity and fuel emissions across clocks made, then add the bought parts per clock: plastic case, glass, movement and packaging, each with a supplier or database factor.
audience: Wall clock and time-piece assemblers in the Morbi cluster of Gujarat

p: Energy: kWh x 0.710 for the month, plus any fuel.
Divide by clocks finished that month.
Add materials per clock with their sources.
Quartz movements may be imported. If the supplier gives no figure, mark that line as a gap instead of filling it.

senseible: Senseible reads the energy invoices behind the making stage into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, and keeps material invoices on the Scope 3 trail. Material factors come from your supplier or a named database and are labelled with their source, so the product figure can be traced line by line.
